RFC7440-3-1.note: 'All fields except opc MUST be ASCII strings followed by a single-byte NULL.' TestTFTPParseRRQ/TestTFTPParseRRQInvalid (tftpserver) prove the NUL terminator for filename and mode only: 'no filename NUL' and 'no mode NUL' are rejected. No assertion covers the ASCII clause (a non-ASCII byte in a field is accepted untested), and the windowsize option name/value fields this section defines are not exercised, since ze does not implement the option.
